gen.title: Seeing Cosine as a Function of Angle Through Scaling
gen.orderNote: Follow black to red to blue triangles to see cosine ratio stay the same

steps.label: black triangle
steps.quote: For the black triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to x divided by y.
steps.orderHint: Start with the smallest triangle's adjacent to hypotenuse ratio

steps.label: red triangle
steps.quote: For the red triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to 2x divided by 2y.
steps.orderHint: Double the sides and see how the ratio is written

steps.label: same value as the black triangle
steps.quote: Dividing out the “2’s” gives x divided by y, the same value as the black triangle.
steps.orderHint: Cancel the common factor to find the unchanged ratio

steps.label: blue triangle
steps.quote: For the blue triangle, the cosine of “b” is equal to 3x divided by 3y.
steps.orderHint: Triple the sides and check the ratio again

steps.label: value of cosine “b” just depends
steps.quote: The value of cosine “b” just depends on the value of “b” and not the length of the sides that form “b”.
steps.orderHint: Conclude that cosine depends on angle not side length
